tasks.description: Audit visual hierarchy, observability workflows, responsive behavior, and accessibility with independent read-only reviewers.
Replace the inventory-like default with stable project-first clusters and progressive capability drill-down.
Implement the compact command surface, search-to-focus workflow, accessible navigator, and selection-driven inspector.
Add bounded API loading, fallback provenance, freshness, empty/error recovery, local browser dependencies, and responsive resizing.
Record design principles, completed release blockers, measurable outcomes, and prioritized follow-up work.
Run model tests, production build, browser screenshots, interaction checks, and independent regression review.
tasks.note: All executable gates passed. Three independent specialist reviews informed the work; the final delegated regression review was unavailable due to its service usage limit and was replaced by a documented local release audit.
